title: trace/1: a chromatogram or XIC, `mzlab-cli trace chrom|xic`
description: One trace of a file. x is the retention time in minutes. The same points as CSV (`--format csv`) have the header rt_min,intensity. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/trace_cmd.rs.

id.description: The channel id (tic, bpc, srm:..., uv:..., an:..., dd:..., ms:...) or xic:<mz>.

sample.description: Sample id of a multi-sample file (.wiff); null for an mzML.

y_unit.description: counts, mAU, bar, ... as the channel reports it.

points.description: [x, y] pairs; the number tokens are the page route's own bytes.

ions.description: Only with `trace xic --ions` and a factor: the trace in ions, one number per point of `points` (the same --rt window). With the factor of evidence.ion_scale: ions = round(round(cps, 1) x ions_per_cps, 3). A CSV gets the column `ions` (a list of ions: `ions:<mz>` after each `xic:<mz>`).

evidence.description: Where the points come from: source or route, channel, tolerance (tolerance_da, tolerance_ppm), scans_in_section, points_in_source, rt_window_min, smooth (3 or 5, XIC only) and, for an XIC with no signal, empty: true with empty_reason (no_scans_in_section, no_signal or outside_window). With --mz-offset: mz_offset_da and mz_offset. Convention: mz_offset_da = observed - true, in Da (|DA| <= 0.6). A trace asked for the true m/z M integrates [M + offset - tol, M + offset + tol] and reports M; a corrected m/z is observed - offset. Written only when an offset is in force (default 0 writes nothing). mz_offset is {mode:'fixed'} for a given number, or {mode:'auto',ion_mz,rt_min,status ok|wide|not_found,n_scans,apex_rt_min,apex_intensity,spread_da,snr} for one measured on a known ion (not_found: offset 0). With `trace xic --ions`: ion_scale (the factor and where it came from, or null when neither the method nor the data gave one; then the trace stays in cps and has no `ions`), ion_scale_choice (the log of the choice) and ion_method_choices (what was read from the method/1 of the file).
